usage: `niagara.CreateShadersOnLoad=<值>` / `niagara.CreateShadersOnLoad <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to create Niagara's simulation shaders on load, which can reduce hitching, but use more memory.  Otherwise they will be created as needed.

usage: `Niagara.RadixSortThreshold=<值>` / `Niagara.RadixSortThreshold <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Instance count at which radix sort gets used instead of introspective sort.\n

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.ForceIndex32=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.ForceIndex32 <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Force creating 32 bits index buffers for the ribbons.

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuAllocateMaxCount=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuAllocateMaxCount <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled (default) we allocate the maximum number of required elements.

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuBufferAlign=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuBufferAlign <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When not allocating the maximum number of required elements we align up the request elements to this size to improve buffer reuse.

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuBufferCachePurgeCounter=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuBufferCachePurgeCounter <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The number of frames we hold onto ribbon buffer for.

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuEnabled=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuEnabled <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable any GPU ribbon related code (including GPU init).

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuInitMode=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.GpuInitMode <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Modifies the GPU initialization mode used, i.e. offloading CPU calculations to the GPU.\n

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.MinSegmentLength=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.MinSegmentLength <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Min length of niagara ribbon segments. (default=1)

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.ShareGeneratedData=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.ShareGeneratedData <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Allow ribbons to share the generate data where possible.

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.Enabled=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.Enabled <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Determine if we allow tesellation on this platform or not.

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MaxErrorScreenPercentage=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MaxErrorScreenPercentage <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Screen percentage used to compute the tessellation factor. \n

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MaxInterp=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MaxInterp <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When TessellationAngle is > 0, this is the maximum tesselation factor. \n

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MinAbsoluteError=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MinAbsoluteError <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Minimum absolute world size error when tessellating. \n

usage: `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MinAngle=<值>` / `Niagara.Ribbon.Tessellation.MinAngle <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Ribbon segment angle to tesselate in radian. (default=15 degrees)

usage: `niagara.ShowShaderCompilerWarnings=<值>` / `niagara.ShowShaderCompilerWarnings <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When set to 1, will display all warnings from Niagara shader compiles.
